raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# PR type

- [ ] Bug Fix
- [ ] New Feature
- [x] Document Updates
- [ ] More Models or Datasets Support

# PR information

Related issue: none linked.
Companion implementation: https://github.com/modelscope/mcore-bridge/pull/251

Add DeepSeek-V4.1 Ascend LoRA examples for single-host reduced-model validation and two-host full-depth training. Update Qwen3.8-Flash-Next examples and paired Chinese/English documentation to use the shared `NGRAM_EMBEDDING_CPU_OFFLOAD` environment variable.

- `megatron_lora.sh`: single host with 8 NPUs, TP1/PP1/EP8 and 2K packing.
- `megatron_lora_multinode.sh`: based on the previously successful two-host / 16-NPU full 40-layer text-model configuration, with TP1/PP4/EP4, sequence length 256, packing/padding-free disabled and unfused attention.
- Put setup, launch instructions, resource requirements and validation scope in Chinese/English READMEs next to the scripts.
- Replace `PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD` in the Qwen examples and explain compatibility: the legacy variable remains a fallback when the new variable is unset; an explicit new value of `0` takes precedence.

This PR changes examples and documentation only. The companion mcore-bridge change is required for the shared switch and DeepSeek Engram CPU offload. CPU-resident tables stay frozen.

AI assistance was used to prepare, review and validate these changes and write this description.

## Experiment results

Checks passed:

```bash
pre-commit run --all-files
bash -n examples/ascend/train/deepseek_v41/megatron_lora.sh \
    examples/ascend/train/deepseek_v41/megatron_lora_multinode.sh \
    examples/models/qwen4_exp/megatron_sft.sh \
    examples/models/qwen4_exp/megatron_grpo.sh
```

- **Current implementation, single host:** completed 10 BF16 LoRA steps on 8 Ascend 950DT devices with a four-layer text checkpoint, EP8 and 2K packing. Loss changed from 13.33709621 to 12.74300385, gradient norms were finite and nonzero, and adapter checkpoints were saved at steps 5 and 10. All 8 workers used the current checkouts; 80 audited packed batches contained 2025–2048 tokens. The checkpoint retained the original hidden size/expert count and one Engram table; this is reduced-model validation.
- **Historical full-depth run:** completed 10 steps on two hosts / 16 Ascend 950DT devices with the full 40-layer text checkpoint, TP1/PP4/EP4, length 256 and short sample data. Step 5 and step 10 each saved 16 checkpoint shards; 120 LoRA B tensors were finite, nonzero and updated between saves. This run used the earlier offload argument and a host-specific NUMA launcher. The new two-host example uses the shared environment variable and has not been rerun on two hosts with the final code.
- The companion bridge regression suite passed all 27 tests. Existing Qwen GPU examples were not rerun.
- These results do not validate full-parameter training, vision, long-sequence full-model training or full HF export.

# Checklist

- [ ] I have linked the related issue above, if there is one.
- [ ] I have reviewed and understand every changed line, and I can explain how the change works and why it is correct.
- [ ] I have run the relevant tests or reproductions locally, and included the commands and results above (if applicable).
- [ ] I am responsible for the content of this PR, regardless of how it was produced.

+# DeepSeek-V4.1 LoRA example
+
+[中文](README_CN.md)
+
+## Single-host reduced-model validation
+
+The [example script](megatron_lora.sh) uses TP=1, PP=1, CP=1 and EP=8 to train attention-projection LoRA parameters on NPU. `NGRAM_EMBEDDING_CPU_OFFLOAD=1` keeps frozen, EP-sharded Engram tables in CPU memory; other computation stays on NPU. The defaults enable 2K packing and save Megatron-format adapter checkpoints without merging the full model.
+
+Load the CANN environment first and prepare the matching DeepSeek-V4.1 NPU stack: `torch_npu`, MegatronAdaptor, TransformerEngineNPU, Megatron-Core with the native Engram extension, and mcore-bridge with this adaptation. The validated software combination is torch 2.10.0, torch-npu 2.10.0.post2, CANN 9.2.0, local MCore 0.19.0 and transformers 5.12.1. Standard GPU installation commands do not replace these NPU components.
+
+```bash
+MODEL=/path/to/deepseek-v41-checkpoint \
+ENGRAM_TOKENIZER_MAP=/path/to/engram_tokenizer_map.json \
+DATASET=/path/to/train.jsonl \
+OUTPUT_DIR=megatron_output/deepseek-v41-npu-lora \
+bash examples/ascend/train/deepseek_v41/megatron_lora.sh
+```
+
+`MODEL` is a required local checkpoint directory. If `ENGRAM_TOKENIZER_MAP` is unset, the script reads `engram_tokenizer_map.json` from that directory. The map must match the checkpoint's tokenizer, original layer IDs and vocabulary; generate it with the matching MCore `tools/engram/generate_tokenizer_map.py`. `DATASET` accepts local data or defaults to the example dataset in the script. Adjust `TRAIN_ITERS`, `SAVE_STEPS`, `MAX_LENGTH` and `GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE`. Configure visible devices and communication interfaces for your host; no interface or NUMA layout is hard-coded.
+
+The single-host script completed 10 training steps in this configuration and saved adapter checkpoints at steps 5 and 10.
+
+Validation covers one host with 8 Ascend 950DT devices and a four-layer text checkpoint retaining the original hidden size, expert count and one Engram table. It includes ordinary attention, MoE, hyper-connections and a CSA2 ratio-2 source/reuse pair. It excludes ratio-1/candidate paths, DSpark, vision, the complete 40-layer model and multi-node training. CPU memory must fit all local Engram shards plus model-loading temporaries. Reduced-model results do not establish full-model compatibility; see below for historical two-host full-model validation. This script does not validate full-parameter training or full HF model export.
+
+## Two-host full-depth model
+
+The [two-host script](megatron_lora_multinode.sh) follows the previously successful configuration for the complete 40-layer text model: 2 hosts with 8 NPUs each, TP=1, PP=4, CP=1, EP=4, micro batch size 1 and global batch size 4. It defaults to sequence length 256, disables packing and padding-free execution, and uses `unfused` attention. `NGRAM_EMBEDDING_CPU_OFFLOAD=1` freezes Engram tables and keeps them on CPU.
+
+Load the matching CANN/NPU environment on both hosts and prepare identical checkpoints, tokenizer maps and datasets. Run the following from the repository root on each host:
+
+```bash
+# Node 0
+NODE_RANK=0 MASTER_ADDR=<node-0-communication-IP> \
+MODEL=/path/to/full-deepseek-v41-checkpoint \
+ENGRAM_TOKENIZER_MAP=/path/to/engram_tokenizer_map.json \
+DATASET=/path/to/train.jsonl \
+OUTPUT_DIR=/path/to/shared-output \
+bash examples/ascend/train/deepseek_v41/megatron_lora_multinode.sh
+
+# Node 1: use the same MASTER_ADDR, MASTER_PORT and OUTPUT_DIR as node 0
+NODE_RANK=1 MASTER_ADDR=<node-0-communication-IP> \
+MODEL=/path/to/full-deepseek-v41-checkpoint \
+ENGRAM_TOKENIZER_MAP=/path/to/engram_tokenizer_map.json \
+DATASET=/path/to/train.jsonl \
+OUTPUT_DIR=/path/to/shared-output \
+bash examples/ascend/train/deepseek_v41/megatron_lora_multinode.sh
+```
+
+Replace `<node-0-communication-IP>` with an address reachable from both hosts. Set `HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME` and `GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME` for each host. Use a shared `OUTPUT_DIR` accessible from both hosts; automatic version suffixes are disabled so both nodes save the same training run. The successful run also used a NUMA Python launcher with CPU/memory binding matched to each host's NPU topology. Set `PYTHON_EXEC` to such a launcher when needed, using the actual host topology rather than another machine's NUMA IDs. Host memory must fit local Engram shards and loading temporaries.
+
+The historical run completed 10 steps on 16 Ascend 950DT devices across two hosts, using the full 40-layer text checkpoint and short samples with a maximum length of 256. Checkpoints at steps 5 and 10 each contained 16 shards. All 120 LoRA B tensors were finite and nonzero, and changed between the two checkpoints. This validation used the earlier offload argument; the script now uses the shared environment variable and has not been rerun on two hosts with the current code. Long sequences, vision, full-parameter training and full HF export were outside that validation.

+# DeepSeek-V4.1 LoRA 示例
+
+[English](README.md)
+
+## 单机减层验证
+
+[示例脚本](megatron_lora.sh)使用 TP=1、PP=1、CP=1、EP=8，在 NPU 上训练注意力投影的 LoRA 参数。`NGRAM_EMBEDDING_CPU_OFFLOAD=1` 将 Engram 词表冻结并按 EP 分片保留在 CPU，其他计算仍在 NPU 上。默认开启 2K packing，保存 Megatron 格式的 adapter checkpoint（不合并完整模型）。
+
+先加载 CANN 环境，并准备与 DeepSeek-V4.1 适配匹配的 `torch_npu`、MegatronAdaptor、TransformerEngineNPU、包含原生 Engram 扩展的 Megatron-Core 和 mcore-bridge。已验证的软件组合为 torch 2.10.0、torch-npu 2.10.0.post2、CANN 9.2.0、本地 MCore 0.19.0 和 transformers 5.12.1；普通 GPU 环境的安装命令不能直接替代这些 NPU 组件。
+
+```bash
+MODEL=/path/to/deepseek-v41-checkpoint \
+ENGRAM_TOKENIZER_MAP=/path/to/engram_tokenizer_map.json \
+DATASET=/path/to/train.jsonl \
+OUTPUT_DIR=megatron_output/deepseek-v41-npu-lora \
+bash examples/ascend/train/deepseek_v41/megatron_lora.sh
+```
+
+`MODEL` 为必填的本地 checkpoint 目录；未指定 `ENGRAM_TOKENIZER_MAP` 时，读取该目录下的 `engram_tokenizer_map.json`。此文件必须与 checkpoint 的 tokenizer、原始层号和词表匹配，可使用配套 MCore 的 `tools/engram/generate_tokenizer_map.py` 生成。`DATASET` 支持本地数据，也可省略以使用脚本中的示例数据集。可通过 `TRAIN_ITERS`、`SAVE_STEPS`、`MAX_LENGTH`、`GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE` 调整训练规模。设备可见性及通信网卡应按机器环境设置，脚本不写死网卡或 NUMA 布局。
+
+单机脚本在上述配置下完成了 10 个训练 step，并成功保存 step 5 和 step 10 的 adapter checkpoint。
+
+验证范围为单机 8 张 Ascend 950DT、4 层文本 checkpoint，保留原始隐藏维度、专家规模和一个 Engram 词表，覆盖普通注意力、MoE、hyper-connections 和 CSA2 ratio-2 的 source/reuse 配对。它不覆盖 ratio-1/candidate、DSpark、视觉分支、完整 40 层模型或多机训练。CPU 需要容纳本机所有 Engram 词表分片以及模型加载的临时内存；不能把减层结果直接外推到完整模型；双机完整模型的历史验证见下文。此脚本也不验证全参训练或完整 HF 模型导出。
+
+## 双机完整模型
+
+[双机脚本](megatron_lora_multinode.sh)基于此前完整 40 层文本模型跑通的配置：2 台机器，每台 8 张 NPU，TP=1、PP=4、CP=1、EP=4，micro batch size 为 1，global batch size 为 4。默认序列长度 256，关闭 packing 和 padding-free，使用 `unfused` attention；Engram 词表通过 `NGRAM_EMBEDDING_CPU_OFFLOAD=1` 冻结并保留在 CPU。
+
+两台机器先加载匹配的 CANN/NPU 环境，准备相同 checkpoint、tokenizer map 和数据集。分别在仓库根目录运行：
+
+```bash
+# 节点 0
+NODE_RANK=0 MASTER_ADDR=<节点0的通信IP> \
+MODEL=/path/to/full-deepseek-v41-checkpoint \
+ENGRAM_TOKENIZER_MAP=/path/to/engram_tokenizer_map.json \
+DATASET=/path/to/train.jsonl \
+OUTPUT_DIR=/path/to/shared-output \
+bash examples/ascend/train/deepseek_v41/megatron_lora_multinode.sh
+
+# 节点 1：MASTER_ADDR、MASTER_PORT、OUTPUT_DIR 与节点 0 相同
+NODE_RANK=1 MASTER_ADDR=<节点0的通信IP> \
+MODEL=/path/to/full-deepseek-v41-checkpoint \
+ENGRAM_TOKENIZER_MAP=/path/to/engram_tokenizer_map.json \
+DATASET=/path/to/train.jsonl \
+OUTPUT_DIR=/path/to/shared-output \
+bash examples/ascend/train/deepseek_v41/megatron_lora_multinode.sh
+```
+
+将 `<节点0的通信IP>` 替换为两台机器均可访问的实际地址，并按各自机器设置 `HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME` 和 `GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME`。`OUTPUT_DIR` 使用两台机器均可访问的共享目录；脚本关闭自动版本后缀，确保两个节点写入同一次训练的 checkpoint。此前成功运行还使用了按本机 NPU/CPU 拓扑绑定的 NUMA Python launcher，可通过 `PYTHON_EXEC` 指定这类 launcher；需要按实际拓扑配置，不能直接照搬其他机器的 NUMA 编号。CPU 内存需要容纳本机 Engram 分片和加载临时数据。
+
+此前在双机 16 张 Ascend 950DT、完整 40 层文本 checkpoint、256 长度短样本数据下完成 10 步，step 5 和 10 各保存了 16 个 checkpoint 分片，120 个 LoRA B 张量均为有限非零值，并在两个 checkpoint 之间发生更新。这是旧 offload 参数入口下的历史验证；本脚本已换用统一环境变量，尚未在当前代码上重跑双机。长序列、视觉分支、全参训练和完整 HF 导出不在该次验证范围内。

@@ -0,0 +1,79 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# DeepSeek-V4.1 text-only LoRA on Ascend NPU, with frozen Engram tables on CPU.
+# Load CANN and the matching NPU/Megatron environment before running this script.
+# Tested on a four-layer checkpoint with 8 Ascend 950DT devices; full-model training
+# requires separate memory planning and validation. See README.md in this directory.
+set -eo pipefail
+
+MODEL=${MODEL:?Set MODEL to a local DeepSeek-V4.1 checkpoint directory}
+DATASET=${DATASET:-'AI-ModelScope/alpaca-gpt4-data-zh#500'}
+ENGRAM_TOKENIZER_MAP=${ENGRAM_TOKENIZER_MAP:-"${MODEL}/engram_tokenizer_map.json"}
+OUTPUT_DIR=${OUTPUT_DIR:-megatron_output/deepseek-v41-npu-lora}
+MAX_LENGTH=${MAX_LENGTH:-2048}
+TRAIN_ITERS=${TRAIN_ITERS:-10}
+SAVE_STEPS=${SAVE_STEPS:-5}
+GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE=${GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE:-8}
+
+export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=${ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES:-0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7}
+export NPROC_PER_NODE=${NPROC_PER_NODE:-8}
+export NNODES=${NNODES:-1}
+export NODE_RANK=${NODE_RANK:-0}
+export MASTER_ADDR=${MASTER_ADDR:-127.0.0.1}
+export MASTER_PORT=${MASTER_PORT:-29500}
+export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
+export NGRAM_EMBEDDING_CPU_OFFLOAD=1
+
+# The map must match the checkpoint's tokenizer, hash layer IDs and vocabulary.
+# Prepare it with the matching MCore tools/engram/generate_tokenizer_map.py.
+megatron sft \
+    --model "${MODEL}" \
+    --model_type deepseek_v41 \
+    --dataset "${DATASET}" \
+    --split_dataset_ratio 0 \
+    --language_model_only true \
+    --engram_tokenizer_map "${ENGRAM_TOKENIZER_MAP}" \

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# DeepSeek-V4.1 full-depth text-only LoRA on 2 hosts with 8 Ascend NPUs each.
+# Based on the validated TP1/PP4/EP4 run; load the matching CANN/NPU environment.
+# Set NODE_RANK=0/1 and the same MASTER_ADDR on both hosts. See README.md.
+set -eo pipefail
+
+MODEL=${MODEL:?Set MODEL to a local DeepSeek-V4.1 checkpoint directory}
+DATASET=${DATASET:-'AI-ModelScope/alpaca-gpt4-data-zh#500'}
+ENGRAM_TOKENIZER_MAP=${ENGRAM_TOKENIZER_MAP:-"${MODEL}/engram_tokenizer_map.json"}
+OUTPUT_DIR=${OUTPUT_DIR:-megatron_output/deepseek-v41-npu-lora-multinode}
+MAX_LENGTH=${MAX_LENGTH:-256}
+TRAIN_ITERS=${TRAIN_ITERS:-10}
+SAVE_STEPS=${SAVE_STEPS:-5}
+GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE=${GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE:-4}
+
+export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=${ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES:-0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7}
+export NPROC_PER_NODE=${NPROC_PER_NODE:-8}
+export NNODES=2
+export NODE_RANK=${NODE_RANK:?Set NODE_RANK to 0 or 1}
+export MASTER_ADDR=${MASTER_ADDR:?Set MASTER_ADDR to the reachable address of node 0}
+export MASTER_PORT=${MASTER_PORT:-29500}
+export HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=${HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT:-600}
+export HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT=${HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT:-600}
+export HCCL_NPU_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE=${HCCL_NPU_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE:-auto}
+export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
+export NGRAM_EMBEDDING_CPU_OFFLOAD=1
+
+# The map must match the checkpoint's tokenizer, hash layer IDs and vocabulary.
+# Prepare it with the matching MCore tools/engram/generate_tokenizer_map.py.
+megatron sft \
+    --model "${MODEL}" \
+    --model_type deepseek_v41 \
+    --dataset "${DATASET}" \
+    --split_dataset_ratio 0 \
+    --language_model_only true \
+    --engram_tokenizer_map "${ENGRAM_TOKENIZER_MAP}" \
+    --tensor_model_parallel_size 1 \
+    --pipeline_model_parallel_size 4 \
+    --context_parallel_size 1 \
+    --expert_model_parallel_size 4 \
+    --expert_tensor_parallel_size 1 \
+    --sequence_parallel false \
+    --use_cpu_initialization true \
+    --bf16 true \
+    --tuner_type lora \
+    --lora_rank 8 \
+    --lora_alpha 16 \
+    --lora_dropout 0 \
+    --target_regex '^(?!.*dspark).*\.(linear_q_down_proj|linear_q_up_proj|linear_proj)$' \
+    --micro_batch_size 1 \
+    --global_batch_size "${GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE}" \
+    --max_length "${MAX_LENGTH}" \
+    --padding_free false \
+    --packing false \
+    --attention_backend unfused \
+    --train_iters "${TRAIN_ITERS}" \
+    --lr 1e-4 \
+    --lr_decay_style constant \
+    --weight_decay 0 \
+    --seed 42 \
+    --recompute_granularity none \
+    --gradient_accumulation_fusion false \
+    --moe_grouped_gemm true \
+    --moe_permute_fusion false \
+    --masked_softmax_fusion false \
+    --bias_activation_fusion false \
+    --bias_dropout_fusion false \
+    --apply_rope_fusion false \
+    --save_safetensors false \
+    --merge_lora false \
+    --save_steps "${SAVE_STEPS}" \
+    --eval_iters 0 \
+    --dataset_num_proc 1 \
+    --dataloader_num_workers 0 \
+    --logging_steps 1 \
+    --report_to tensorboard \
+    --check_model false \
+    --add_version false \
+    --output_dir "${OUTPUT_DIR}"
